envelope.description: Define recovery contracts and prove crash-test infrastructure

body.title: Define recovery contracts and prove crash-test infrastructure
body.summary: Add recovery-types.ts exact sc4 projections, internal manifest/event/error types and validation boundaries. Add new recovery-fixtures.ts/recovery-worker.ts child fixture with temporary project root and deterministic fault handshakes; prove parent can stop worker at a known boundary and reopen files. Treat existing s2/s3 contracts as consumed.
acceptanceChecks: ReviewRecoveryV1 and ResumeCompatibilityV1 match approved sc4; strict version/identity/error validation rejects malformed input.
Child-process fixture reaches deterministic handshake, is killed and reopens the same temporary runtime root; test has bounded timeout and cleanup.
No shared sc1/sc2/sc3/sc6 signature, MCP or default engine changes.

tests.name: Recovery contract shapes, version and identity refusal
Bounded child-worker handshake kill and reopen feasibility
